analysis:
Independently checked the supplied analysis against all replayed patches and metadata. .github/workflows/provider-plan.yml:184–195 changes test-lane requests to 8x16, except GPU shard 2 to 12x32; build sizes, lane counts, component conditions and fallback labels remain unchanged. docs/developer/build.md:622–633 and 666–679 and changelog.d/ci-interim-job-sizes.md:3 consistently document the interim sizes and reduced memory headroom. File modes remain non-executable.

Reduced headroom could cause CI resource failures, but the evidence does not establish skipped tests, fail-open release checks or weakened artifact qualification (A-011, A-017, T-054). No supported security regression follows from that operational risk. No supplied change modifies provider authorization, attestation, encryption, plaintext handling, billing, privileged helpers or T-041 cache isolation, persistence and purge controls. No threat-model update is warranted by the observed CI sizing changes.

Coverage is bounded: the replay omits three previously reviewed units and does not include route/test workflow implementations or scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py. Actual signed-shape acceptance and test failure propagation are external contracts, not independently verified here; their absence is not evidence of a missing control. The supplied changes do not establish a material unresolved security question requiring deeper review.
